raw_html: [[Enhancement bonus|+2 Orb Bonus]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Enhancement bonus|+2 Orb Bonus]]:''' While this [[orb]] is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +2 [[Enhancement bonus|orb bonus]] to all [[saving throw]]s, as well as [[Energy Resistance|Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances]].
